description: This file defines the interface and data structures for dynamic array handling in the project, including functions for array initialization, manipulation, querying, and memory management.

methods.name: array_data_string_init
methods.description: Initializes a new data_string object.

methods.name: array_data_array_init
methods.description: Initializes a new data_array object.

methods.name: array_data_integer_init
methods.description: Initializes a new data_integer object.

methods.name: array_init
methods.description: Initializes a new array with specified capacity.

methods.name: array_copy_array
methods.description: Copies array data from source to destination.

methods.name: array_free_data
methods.description: Frees data within the array.

methods.name: array_free
methods.description: Frees the array completely.

methods.name: array_reset_data_strings
methods.description: Resets data string fields within the array.

methods.name: array_insert_unique
methods.description: Inserts an entry into the array if it does not already exist.

methods.name: array_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element of the array.

methods.name: array_is_vlist
methods.description: Checks if the array is a list with numeric keys.

methods.name: array_is_kvany
methods.description: Checks if the array is a key-value list with any keys.

methods.name: array_is_kvarray
methods.description: Checks if the array is a key-value array with string keys.

methods.name: array_is_kvstring
methods.description: Checks if the array is a key-value array with string keys.

methods.name: array_get_element_klen_ext
methods.description: Retrieves an element matching the key with extension consideration.

methods.name: array_get_element_klen
methods.description: Retrieves an element with a specific key and length.

methods.name: array_get_data_unset
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a key.

methods.name: array_extract_element_klen
methods.description: Removes and returns element matching key and length.

methods.name: array_get_int_ptr
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to integer data for a key.

methods.name: array_get_buf_ptr_ext
methods.description: Retrieves buffer pointer for a key with extension.

methods.name: array_get_buf_ptr
methods.description: Retrieves buffer pointer for a key.

methods.name: array_insert_value
methods.description: Inserts a value into the array.

methods.name: void array_set_key_value(array * const a,const char * const k,const uint32_t klen,const char * const v,const uint32_t vlen)
methods.description: Sets key and value in the array.

methods.name: array_replace
methods.description: Replaces data in the array with new entry.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix_klen
methods.description: Finds element with key prefix matching string and length.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix_nc_klen
methods.description: Finds element with key prefix (case-insensitive) with string and length.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix
methods.description: Finds element with key prefix matching buffer.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix_nc
methods.description: Finds element with key prefix (case-insensitive) matching buffer.

methods.name: array_match_value_prefix
methods.description: Finds value with prefix matching buffer.

methods.name: array_match_value_prefix_nc
methods.description: Finds value with case-insensitive prefix matching buffer.

methods.name: array_match_key_suffix
methods.description: Finds element with key suffix matching buffer.

methods.name: array_match_key_suffix_nc
methods.description: Finds element with case-insensitive key suffix.

methods.name: array_match_value_suffix
methods.description: Finds value with suffix matching buffer.

methods.name: array_match_value_suffix_nc
methods.description: Finds value with case-insensitive suffix.

methods.name: array_match_path_or_ext
methods.description: Finds data matching path or extension.
